newsitem.title: THAILAND: Telekom Malaysia set to up stake in Samart Corp.
newsitem.headline: Telekom Malaysia set to up stake in Samart Corp.

text.p: Telekom Malaysia Bhd will be offered an increased stake in Thai communications firm Samart Corporation Plc, Samart said on Monday.
Samart will offer a further 4.53 million shares to Telekom Malaysia at 100 baht per share. This will take the Malaysian's stake in the firm to 24.99 percent, a Samart statement said.

The two firms signed an agreement in June worth around $200 million in which Samart was to buy 14 million Samart shares representing 20.12 percent of the company. The deal also included investment in Samart's mobile phone subsidiary Digital Phone Co Ltd.
The private placement to Telekom Malaysia accounts for the majority of 6.42 million shares which remain unsubscribed from a recent capital increase, Samart said.
The increased sale is subject to Samart shareholders' approval, the statement said.
Samart shares rose 0.50 baht to 84.50 by 0436 GMT. The broader Thai market was up 23.39 points or 3.62 percent to 669.97 by 0445 GMT. ($1 = 32 baht)
